-- Returns the text of file `name` inside the directory `notes`.
-- Names are untrusted: only files inside `notes` may be read.
-- A missing or unreadable file, or a name that escapes `notes`, gives "".
read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  pre name.char_count() <= 255
  post out.char_count() >= 0
  ex read_note("missing.txt") == ""
  ex read_note("../secret.txt") == ""
  if name.char_count() == 0 or name.split("/").len() > 1 or name.split("\\").len() > 1 or name.split("..").len() > 1
    return ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    fs.read(name) else err -> ""
